title: Trusted Mode in a Fence
description: The run command that disables the agent's permission prompts inside a container constrained by several isolation flags.

steps.description: The comment says this is reasonable only because of the flags around it. Run interactively, remove on exit, and mount the project at `/work`.
Mount the notes vault at `/reference` read-only, so the agent can read reference material but cannot change it.
Cut the network with `--network none`, drop all capabilities with `--cap-drop ALL`, and forbid privilege escalation with `--security-opt no-new-privileges`.
Limit process count with `--pids-limit 256`, cap memory at `--memory 4g`, and pass `AGENT_API_KEY` through from your shell.
Run `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`. The page says to read the command as a sentence: the agent may act without asking, and the worst it can do is damage one git-tracked folder.
